notes: Signal timing for the synthetic 3x3 grid. Green phase 0 serves north-south, phase 1 east-west, at every junction (checked by tests/test_fixed_time.py). Tuned plans were chosen by a sweep on dev seeds 100-101 (900 s warm-up + 3600 s), never on evaluation seeds; see scenarios/grid3x3/README.md. Change 'version' whenever a value here changes. Version 6 (task 3.7): corridor_min_green_s = 5, emergency truncation of minimum green for green-corridor requests only; yellow and all-red unchanged; normal control keeps 10 s.

equal.description: Reference: 35 s green per phase, 80 s cycle, no offsets.

light.description: Tuned for light demand: 20/20 s, 50 s cycle.

medium.description: Tuned for medium demand: 25/25 s, 60 s cycle.

heavy.description: Tuned for heavy demand: 45/45 s, 100 s cycle.

uneven.description: Tuned for uneven demand: 45 s north-south / 25 s east-west, 80 s cycle.

adaptive.description: Pressure controller (D2 Eq 5.2). One parameter set for every profile, frozen after two sweeps on dev seeds 100-101 (60 settings); see scenarios/grid3x3/README.md.

dqn.description: Parameter-sharing DQN trained on CPU (models/dqn/grid3x3/training.json). Checkpoint chosen on dev seeds 100-101 by the rule fixed in manzil/experiments/train_dqn.py.
